title: archkeel studio — From a cold scan to the browser map

story.title: archkeel studio — From a cold scan to the browser map

steps.title: Explore command
steps.note: Select the project and prepare a scan.

steps.title: Choose the cold path
steps.note: A missing matching snapshot selects the cold build path. The call binding from the command remains unresolved.

steps.title: Prepare the scan
steps.note: The publisher requests a fresh scan before preparing the snapshot.

steps.title: Prepare the core request
steps.note: The scan callback serializes the request and asks the native core for a frame. The callback binding is unresolved.

steps.title: Start the core process
steps.note: The shell runs the core with the scan request on standard input and captures its output.

steps.title: Read the request
steps.note: The Rust child selects the scan request and reads the request bytes from standard input. The cross-process binding is not resolved.

steps.title: Dispatch the scan
steps.note: The scan entry delegates the request to the core scan implementation.

steps.title: Collect and evaluate
steps.note: The core runs collection and evaluation, and prepares a frame for its caller.

steps.title: Return the scan result
steps.note: The scan result returns to the scan entry. This is a return, not a reverse call.

steps.title: Write the frame
steps.note: The core writes the frame to standard output. The return path is not observed at runtime.

steps.title: Receive the frame
steps.note: The shell receives the child process output and exit code. The process response is not resolved as a call edge.

steps.title: Return to the scan
steps.note: The exchange returns the captured frame bytes to the scan wrapper.

steps.title: Validate the frame
steps.note: The scan wrapper reads the frame and checks its protocol and request binding.

steps.title: Return the checked frame
steps.note: The frame reader returns to the wrapper. A static call does not prove a runtime return.

steps.title: Prepare the snapshot
steps.note: The scan callback returns the frame to the publisher. Its dynamic binding is unresolved.

steps.title: Publish the snapshot
steps.note: The publisher builds a database when no matching snapshot exists.

steps.title: Write the database
steps.note: The builder opens a temporary SQLite database and writes its snapshot transaction. The SQLite binding remains unknown.

steps.title: Serve Studio on localhost
steps.note: After the snapshot is published, the launcher verifies its identity, starts the HTTP server and prints its local address.

steps.title: Display the architecture map
steps.note: The browser opens the system scope, requests the map and renders the returned groups. The browser request is a separate event.
